照耀.zh: 月光照耀在平静的湖面上，像铺了一层银子。
照耀.en: Moonlight shone on the calm lake, like a layer of silver.

储蓄.zh: 专家建议年轻人养成储蓄的习惯，不要每个月都花光。
储蓄.en: Experts advise young people to get into the habit of saving instead of spending everything each month.

修建.zh: 为了方便村民出行，政府在河上修建了一座石桥。
修建.en: To make travel easier for the villagers, the government built a stone bridge over the river.

盘旋.zh: 飞机因为大雾无法降落，只好在机场上空盘旋。
盘旋.en: Unable to land because of the thick fog, the plane had to circle above the airport.

橙.zh: 他把冰箱里剩下的一个橙切开，分给两个孩子吃。
橙.en: He cut open the last orange in the fridge and shared it between the two children.

懒惰.zh: 想要减肥成功，首先得克服自己懒惰的毛病。
懒惰.en: If you want to lose weight successfully, you first have to overcome your lazy habits.

平庸.zh: 这部电影的剧情十分平庸，看完后我几乎什么都没记住。
平庸.en: The plot of this film was very mediocre; I remembered almost nothing after watching it.

小心翼翼.zh: 新手司机小心翼翼地把车倒进了狭窄的停车位。
小心翼翼.en: The new driver very cautiously reversed the car into the narrow parking space.

可口.zh: 这家餐厅的点心香甜可口，很受孩子们的欢迎。
可口.en: This restaurant's pastries are sweet and tasty, and very popular with children.

默默.zh: 听完批评，他什么也没说，只是默默地低下了头。
默默.en: After hearing the criticism, he said nothing and just silently lowered his head.

题材.zh: 这位作家最擅长写校园题材的小说。
题材.en: This writer is best at writing novels with campus life as their subject matter.

糟蹋.zh: 这么好的布料被你剪坏了，真是糟蹋东西。
糟蹋.en: You've cut up such good fabric and ruined it — what a waste.

生锈.zh: 这把刀很久没用了，刀刃上已经生锈了。
生锈.en: This knife hasn't been used for a long time, and its blade has already rusted.

文物.zh: 这件文物已经有两千多年的历史了，是国家一级保护对象。
文物.en: This cultural relic is over two thousand years old and is under first-class national protection.

弹性.zh: 这种运动鞋的鞋底很有弹性，跑步时脚不会累。
弹性.en: The soles of these trainers are very springy, so your feet don't get tired when you run.

个体.zh: 他辞职后做起了个体户，开了一家小面馆。
个体.en: After quitting his job he became self-employed and opened a small noodle shop.

陶醉.zh: 听到观众热烈的掌声，演员脸上露出了陶醉的神情。
陶醉.en: Hearing the audience's warm applause, the actor's face showed a look of utter delight.

赠送.zh: 这本词典是朋友赠送给我的毕业礼物。
赠送.en: This dictionary was a graduation present given to me by a friend.

海滨.zh: 他们在一座海滨城市买了房子，打算退休后去那里住。
海滨.en: They bought a house in a seaside city and plan to live there after retiring.

庄稼.zh: 秋天到了，农民们正忙着在田里收割庄稼。
庄稼.en: Autumn has arrived, and the farmers are busy harvesting the crops in the fields.

就职.zh: 他大学毕业后就职于一家外贸公司。
就职.en: After graduating from university, he took up a post at a foreign trade company.

叼.zh: 那只猫叼起一条小鱼，飞快地跳上了墙头。
叼.en: The cat picked up a small fish in its mouth and leapt quickly onto the top of the wall.

凡是.zh: 凡是去过那家饭店的人，都说那里的烤鸭好吃。
凡是.en: Everyone who has been to that restaurant says its roast duck is delicious.

轮廓.zh: 画画时，先用铅笔轻轻画出人物脸部的轮廓。
轮廓.en: When drawing, first lightly sketch the outline of the person's face in pencil.

演变.zh: 一次小小的争吵，最后竟然演变成了两家人之间的矛盾。
演变.en: A small quarrel eventually developed into a conflict between the two families.

委员.zh: 每位委员都需要在会议上发表自己的意见。
委员.en: Every committee member needs to give their opinion at the meeting.

二氧化碳.zh: 汽车排放的二氧化碳是造成全球变暖的原因之一。
二氧化碳.en: The carbon dioxide emitted by cars is one of the causes of global warming.

规范.zh: 这家工厂的操作流程很规范，很少出安全事故。
规范.en: This factory's operating procedures are well standardised, and accidents rarely happen.

烘.zh: 他把被雨淋湿的鞋子放在暖气上烘了一个晚上。
烘.en: He put his rain-soaked shoes on the radiator to dry overnight.

灵敏.zh: 这台仪器非常灵敏，空气中有一点点烟雾都能检测出来。
灵敏.en: This instrument is extremely sensitive; it can detect even a trace of smoke in the air.

晋升.zh: 在这家公司，员工每两年有一次晋升的机会。
晋升.en: At this company, employees have a chance of promotion every two years.

分明.zh: 他分明看见了我，却假装没看见。
分明.en: He clearly saw me, but pretended he hadn't.

钩子.zh: 渔夫把鱼饵挂在钩子上，然后把鱼线抛进了河里。
钩子.en: The fisherman put the bait on the hook and then cast the line into the river.

气压.zh: 下雨之前气压往往会降低，人会觉得有点闷。
气压.en: Air pressure often drops before it rains, and people feel a bit stuffy.

恰巧.zh: 我正想给她打电话，恰巧她就给我打来了。
恰巧.en: I was just about to call her when, as it happened, she called me.

境界.zh: 做到宠辱不惊，是人生的一种很高的境界。
境界.en: Remaining unmoved by praise or humiliation is a very high level of attainment in life.

口头.zh: 他们只是口头约定，并没有签正式的合同。
口头.en: They only had a verbal agreement and never signed a formal contract.

创立.zh: 这所学校由一位归国华侨于一九二零年创立。
创立.en: This school was founded in 1920 by an overseas Chinese who had returned home.

不禁.zh: 想起多年没见的外公，他不禁流下了眼泪。
不禁.en: Thinking of the grandfather he hadn't seen for years, he couldn't help shedding tears.

驻扎.zh: 这家公司在上海驻扎了一支技术团队，专门服务亚洲客户。
驻扎.en: The company has stationed a technical team in Shanghai to serve its Asian clients.

情理.zh: 这件事发生在情理之中，大家并不觉得奇怪。
情理.en: This was entirely within reason, so nobody found it strange.

庄严.zh: 法官穿着黑色的长袍，神情庄严地走进了法庭。
庄严.en: Wearing a black robe, the judge walked into the courtroom with a solemn expression.

剧烈.zh: 他突然感到胃部一阵剧烈的疼痛，赶紧去了医院。
剧烈.en: He suddenly felt a severe pain in his stomach and hurried to the hospital.

任性.zh: 都三十岁了，你不能再像小孩子一样任性了。
任性.en: You're thirty now; you can't be as wilful as a little child any more.

严峻.zh: 今年的就业形势十分严峻，毕业生找工作很难。
严峻.en: The job market is very grim this year, and graduates are finding it hard to get work.

辛勤.zh: 感谢老师们一年来的辛勤付出。
辛勤.en: Thank you, teachers, for all your hard work over the past year.

蹬.zh: 这孩子睡觉不老实，半夜总是把被子蹬开。
蹬.en: This child is a restless sleeper and always kicks off the quilt in the middle of the night.

气势.zh: 瀑布从高处倾泻下来，气势十分磅礴。
气势.en: The waterfall pours down from a great height with tremendous force.

呼吁.zh: 学校呼吁家长们多陪孩子读书，少让他们玩手机。
呼吁.en: The school is appealing to parents to read with their children more and let them play on phones less.

含糊.zh: 这是原则问题，我们决不能含糊。
含糊.en: This is a matter of principle; we absolutely cannot be vague about it.

君子.zh: 俗话说“君子动口不动手”，有话好好说，别打架。
君子.en: As the saying goes, "a gentleman uses words, not fists" — talk it over and don't fight.

反面.zh: 我们要从正面和反面两个角度来分析这个问题。
反面.en: We need to analyse this problem from both the positive and the negative side.

卓越.zh: 这位科学家为医学事业做出了卓越的贡献。
卓越.en: This scientist made outstanding contributions to medicine.

充当.zh: 他会说当地话，所以一路上都充当我们的导游。
充当.en: He speaks the local dialect, so he acted as our guide the whole way.

不愧.zh: 这里的风景这么美，不愧被称为“人间天堂”。
不愧.en: The scenery here is so beautiful; it truly deserves to be called "paradise on earth".

领悟.zh: 直到自己当了父母，他才真正领悟到父母的辛苦。
领悟.en: Only when he became a parent himself did he truly grasp how hard his parents had worked.

过瘾.zh: 天气这么热，喝一大杯冰可乐真过瘾！
过瘾.en: In weather this hot, a big glass of iced cola is so satisfying!

资本.zh: 开公司需要一大笔资本，他打算先向银行贷款。
资本.en: Starting a company needs a lot of capital, so he plans to take out a bank loan first.

筛选.zh: 研究人员从上千种植物中筛选出了三种可以入药的。
筛选.en: From over a thousand plants, the researchers screened out three that can be used as medicine.

潇洒.zh: 他挥挥手，潇洒地转身离开了，一点也不留恋。
潇洒.en: He waved, turned and walked off with an easy, carefree air, without a hint of regret.

搁.zh: 这件事不急，可以先搁到下周再说。
搁.en: This isn't urgent; we can put it aside until next week.

当代.zh: 这座美术馆主要展出当代艺术家的作品。
当代.en: This gallery mainly exhibits works by contemporary artists.

坚硬.zh: 这种坚果的外壳十分坚硬，要用锤子才能敲开。
坚硬.en: The shell of this nut is so hard you need a hammer to crack it.

周期.zh: 这个项目的研发周期比较长，至少需要两年。
周期.en: This project's development cycle is quite long; it needs at least two years.

公然.zh: 这名学生公然在考场上用手机查答案，被老师当场抓住。
公然.en: The student brazenly looked up answers on his phone in the exam hall and was caught on the spot.

齐心协力.zh: 村民们齐心协力，只用三天就把倒塌的房子修好了。
齐心协力.en: Working together as one, the villagers repaired the collapsed house in just three days.

高超.zh: 魔术师用高超的技巧把一枚硬币变没了。
高超.en: With masterly skill, the magician made a coin vanish.

高涨.zh: 听说要去春游，同学们的热情空前高涨。
高涨.en: When they heard about the spring outing, the students' enthusiasm ran higher than ever.

顽强.zh: 石缝里长出了一棵小草，它的生命力真顽强。
顽强.en: A blade of grass has grown out of a crack in the rock; its life force is truly tenacious.

逢.zh: 我们家乡有个习俗，逢年过节都要包饺子。
逢.en: In my hometown it's the custom to make dumplings at every New Year and festival.

资深.zh: 这家医院请来了一位资深的心脏科专家。
资深.en: The hospital has brought in a senior heart specialist.

论坛.zh: 下周，北京将举办一场关于人工智能的国际论坛。
论坛.en: Next week Beijing will host an international forum on artificial intelligence.

素质.zh: 这项运动对运动员的身体素质要求很高。
素质.en: This sport places high demands on athletes' physical fitness.

文凭.zh: 他没有大学文凭，但凭着努力成了一名优秀的工程师。
文凭.en: He has no university diploma, but through hard work he became an excellent engineer.

寄托.zh: 离开家乡后，她把思乡之情寄托在一封封家书里。
寄托.en: After leaving her hometown, she poured her homesickness into letter after letter home.

实质.zh: 两种说法表面上不同，实质上是一回事。
实质.en: The two statements differ on the surface, but in essence they are the same thing.

安详.zh: 小猫在温暖的阳光下安详地睡着了。
安详.en: The kitten fell asleep peacefully in the warm sunshine.

丙.zh: 这次评比分为甲、乙、丙三个等级。
丙.en: This assessment is divided into three grades: A, B and C.

上任.zh: 新教练上任后的第一场比赛就赢了。
上任.en: The new coach won the very first match after taking up the post.

鉴别.zh: 现在网上的信息很多，我们要学会鉴别真假。
鉴别.en: There's so much information online now that we must learn to tell true from false.

郑重.zh: 婚礼上，新郎郑重地向新娘许下了承诺。
郑重.en: At the wedding, the groom solemnly made his promise to the bride.

通用.zh: 这种充电器是通用的，各种品牌的手机都能用。
通用.en: This charger is universal; phones of every brand can use it.

谜语.zh: 这个谜语太难了，我想了半天也没猜出来。
谜语.en: This riddle is too hard; I thought about it for ages and still couldn't guess it.

蔑视.zh: 她蔑视那些靠拍马屁往上爬的人。
蔑视.en: She despises people who climb the ladder by flattering others.

拥护.zh: 这位球队队长深受队员们的拥护和爱戴。
拥护.en: The team captain enjoys the strong support and affection of his teammates.

名额.zh: 今年奖学金的名额增加了一倍，有更多学生可以申请。
名额.en: The number of scholarship places has doubled this year, so more students can apply.

仓促.zh: 这么重要的事情，不要仓促做出决定。
仓促.en: For something this important, don't make a hasty decision.

钙.zh: 老年人容易缺钙，所以骨头比较脆，要多晒太阳。
钙.en: Elderly people are prone to calcium deficiency, so their bones are fragile; they should get more sun.

采购.zh: 饭店的厨师每天早上五点就去市场采购新鲜蔬菜。
采购.en: The restaurant's chef goes to the market at five every morning to buy fresh vegetables.

采纳.zh: 他的方案很有创意，最后被评委采纳了。
采纳.en: His plan was very creative, and in the end the judges adopted it.

著作.zh: 鲁迅的著作被翻译成了很多种语言。
著作.en: Lu Xun's works have been translated into many languages.

片断.zh: 他把电影里最感人的几个片断剪在一起，发到了网上。
片断.en: He edited the film's most moving passages together and posted them online.

桥梁.zh: 这座新建成的桥梁把两个岛连在了一起。
桥梁.en: This newly completed bridge links the two islands.

搅拌.zh: 往咖啡里加了糖以后，用勺子轻轻搅拌一下。
搅拌.en: After adding sugar to the coffee, stir it gently with a spoon.

丑恶.zh: 在金钱面前，他终于露出了丑恶的嘴脸。
丑恶.en: Faced with money, he finally revealed his ugly true face.

践踏.zh: 随意嘲笑别人的缺陷，是对别人尊严的践踏。
践踏.en: Casually mocking other people's flaws tramples on their dignity.

被动.zh: 比赛一开始我们就丢了两个球，处于非常被动的局面。
被动.en: We conceded two goals right at the start and were in a very passive position.

甭.zh: 这点小事你甭管了，交给我来办吧。
甭.en: Don't bother with such a small thing; leave it to me.

柔和.zh: 清晨的阳光很柔和，不像中午那么刺眼。
柔和.en: Early-morning sunlight is soft, not as glaring as at noon.

机智.zh: 主持人机智地化解了现场的尴尬。
机智.en: The host cleverly defused the awkwardness on stage.

寻觅.zh: 他走遍了整个城市，终于寻觅到了小时候吃过的那种点心。
寻觅.en: He searched the whole city and finally found the kind of pastry he ate as a child.

密度.zh: 铁的密度比水大，所以会沉到水底。
密度.en: Iron is denser than water, so it sinks to the bottom.

人道.zh: 让工人每天加班十几个小时，这种管理方式很不人道。
人道.en: Making workers do more than ten hours of overtime a day is a very inhumane way to manage.

领会.zh: 读文章时要仔细领会作者的意图。
领会.en: When reading an essay, you should carefully grasp the author's intention.

走漏.zh: 会议的内容必须保密，千万不能走漏风声。
走漏.en: What was said in the meeting must stay confidential; don't let anything leak out.

花瓣.zh: 她把玫瑰花瓣撒进浴缸里，整个房间都香香的。
花瓣.en: She scattered rose petals into the bathtub, and the whole room smelled lovely.

推论.zh: 这个推论缺乏足够的证据，很难让人信服。
推论.en: This inference lacks sufficient evidence and is hard to believe.

恰到好处.zh: 她的妆化得恰到好处，看起来既自然又精神。
恰到好处.en: Her make-up is just right; she looks both natural and lively.

大意.zh: 请用一句话概括这篇文章的大意。
大意.en: Please summarise the gist of this article in one sentence.

飞跃.zh: 从自行车到高铁，中国的交通有了质的飞跃。
飞跃.en: From bicycles to high-speed rail, China's transport has made a qualitative leap.

颠簸.zh: 船在海上颠簸得很厉害，不少乘客都晕船了。
颠簸.en: The boat was tossed about badly at sea, and many passengers got seasick.

阵地.zh: 网络已经成为年轻人表达观点的主要阵地。
阵地.en: The internet has become the main arena where young people express their views.

配备.zh: 这辆新车配备了自动驾驶系统。
配备.en: This new car is equipped with a self-driving system.

调料.zh: 这家火锅店有二十多种调料，顾客可以自己搭配。
调料.en: This hotpot restaurant has more than twenty seasonings that customers can mix themselves.

精华.zh: 这次展览汇集了中国古代绘画的精华。
精华.en: This exhibition brings together the finest of ancient Chinese painting.

支出.zh: 为了买房，他们大大减少了日常生活的支出。
支出.en: To buy a home, they greatly cut their everyday expenses.

开阔.zh: 站在山顶上，视野一下子变得开阔起来。
开阔.en: Standing on the mountaintop, the view suddenly opened up.

座右铭.zh: 我把“失败是成功之母”当作自己的座右铭。
座右铭.en: I take "failure is the mother of success" as my motto.

外行.zh: 这个问题连外行都看得出来，专家怎么会不知道呢？
外行.en: Even a layman can see this problem — how could the experts not know?

土壤.zh: 长期使用化肥会让土壤变得越来越硬。
土壤.en: Long-term use of chemical fertiliser makes the soil harder and harder.

留神.zh: 过马路时一不留神，他差点被车撞到。
留神.en: He didn't pay attention for a moment while crossing the road and was nearly hit by a car.

生态.zh: 大量砍伐树木破坏了当地的生态平衡。
生态.en: Large-scale tree felling has upset the local ecological balance.

理睬.zh: 那只猫很高傲，不管我怎么叫它，它都不理睬。
理睬.en: That cat is very aloof; however I call it, it pays no attention.

标本.zh: 他收集了一百多种蝴蝶标本，摆满了整面墙。
标本.en: He has collected over a hundred butterfly specimens, which fill an entire wall.

分量.zh: 他的话在公司里很有分量，老板也很重视。
分量.en: His words carry a lot of weight in the company; even the boss takes them seriously.

凝视.zh: 小女孩凝视着橱窗里的洋娃娃，久久不肯离开。
凝视.en: The little girl gazed at the doll in the shop window and wouldn't leave for a long time.

信誉.zh: 做生意最重要的是讲信誉，不能欺骗顾客。
信誉.en: The most important thing in business is to keep your good name and never cheat customers.

黄昏.zh: 每到黄昏，海边的天空就会被晚霞染成金色。
黄昏.en: Every evening at dusk, the sky over the sea is dyed gold by the sunset clouds.

请教.zh: 我有个问题想向您请教一下，不知道您现在方便吗？
请教.en: I have a question I'd like to ask your advice on — is now a good time?

私自.zh: 未经允许，任何人都不得私自拆看别人的信件。
私自.en: Without permission, nobody may secretly open other people's letters.

泄气.zh: 比分落后了十分，队员们有点泄气了。
泄气.en: Trailing by ten points, the players began to lose heart.

挥霍.zh: 他一中了彩票就开始大肆挥霍，没几年就花光了。
挥霍.en: As soon as he won the lottery he began squandering money, and it was all gone within a few years.

形态.zh: 水有三种形态：固态、液态和气态。
形态.en: Water takes three forms: solid, liquid and gas.

对策.zh: 针对孩子沉迷游戏的问题，家长们一起讨论了几种对策。
对策.en: The parents discussed several strategies for dealing with children's addiction to games.

哨.zh: 他把手指放进嘴里，打了一声响亮的口哨。
哨.en: He put his fingers in his mouth and gave a loud whistle.

遭殃.zh: 大人吵架，最后遭殃的总是孩子。
遭殃.en: When adults quarrel, it's always the children who end up suffering.

遗留.zh: 考古学家在山洞里发现了古人遗留的工具。
遗留.en: Archaeologists found tools left behind by ancient people in the cave.

还原.zh: 电脑中了病毒，他只好把系统还原到上个星期的状态。
还原.en: His computer got a virus, so he had to restore the system to how it was last week.

薄弱.zh: 找出自己学习上的薄弱环节，再有针对性地练习。
薄弱.en: Find the weak links in your studies and then practise them specifically.

精密.zh: 手表是一种非常精密的机械，零件特别小。
精密.en: A watch is an extremely precise machine with very small parts.

牢固.zh: 这座桥修得非常牢固，已经用了一百多年。
牢固.en: This bridge was built very solidly and has been in use for over a hundred years.

杂技.zh: 这个杂技团的演员能在高空的钢丝上骑自行车。
杂技.en: The performers in this acrobatic troupe can ride a bicycle on a high wire.

全局.zh: 他是队长，必须从全局出发安排每个队员的位置。
全局.en: As captain, he has to arrange every player's position with the big picture in mind.

神仙.zh: 在古代传说里，神仙可以长生不老，还能在天上飞。
神仙.en: In ancient legends, immortals never age and can fly through the sky.

瓦解.zh: 他的谎言被揭穿后，大家对他的信任一下子瓦解了。
瓦解.en: Once his lie was exposed, everyone's trust in him collapsed at once.

晾.zh: 洗完的衣服要及时拿到阳台上晾干。
晾.en: Washed clothes should be taken out to the balcony to dry promptly.

显著.zh: 经过一年的治理，这条河的水质有了显著的改善。
显著.en: After a year of clean-up work, the river's water quality has improved markedly.

提拔.zh: 领导很欣赏这个年轻人，打算提拔他当副主任。
提拔.en: The boss thinks highly of this young man and plans to promote him to deputy director.

得力.zh: 公司能渡过难关，全靠新经理领导得力。
得力.en: The company got through its difficulties entirely thanks to the new manager's capable leadership.

削弱.zh: 对手的主力球员受伤了，整个队的实力被大大削弱。
削弱.en: The opponents' key player was injured, which greatly weakened the whole team.

元宵节.zh: 每年元宵节，城里都会举办热闹的灯会。
元宵节.en: Every year at the Lantern Festival, the city holds a lively lantern fair.

以致.zh: 他开车时一直在看手机，以致撞上了前面的车。
以致.en: He kept looking at his phone while driving, with the result that he hit the car in front.

人为.zh: 调查发现，这次停电不是设备故障，而是人为操作失误造成的。
人为.en: The investigation found the power cut was caused not by equipment failure but by human error.

一度.zh: 这首歌一度非常流行，大街小巷都在放。
一度.en: This song was hugely popular at one time; it was playing on every street.

请柬.zh: 公司周年庆典的请柬已经全部发出去了。
请柬.en: All the invitations to the company's anniversary celebration have been sent out.

裁员.zh: 受经济不景气影响，这家工厂今年裁员三百人。
裁员.en: Hit by the economic slump, the factory laid off three hundred people this year.

结晶.zh: 盐水蒸发以后，杯底留下了白色的结晶。
结晶.en: After the salt water evaporated, white crystals were left at the bottom of the glass.

烟花爆竹.zh: 为了防止火灾，商场附近禁止燃放烟花爆竹。
烟花爆竹.en: To prevent fires, setting off fireworks and firecrackers is banned near the shopping centre.

波浪.zh: 一阵大风吹过，小船随着波浪上下起伏。
波浪.en: A gust of wind blew, and the little boat rose and fell with the waves.

数额.zh: 这笔贷款的数额太大，银行需要进一步审核。
数额.en: The amount of this loan is too large; the bank needs to review it further.

悔恨.zh: 想到自己年轻时没有好好读书，他充满了悔恨。
悔恨.en: Thinking of how he didn't study properly when young, he was filled with remorse.

尖锐.zh: 这篇文章尖锐地批评了教育中存在的问题。
尖锐.en: This article sharply criticises the problems that exist in education.

垂直.zh: 这面墙并不垂直于地面，看上去有点歪。
垂直.en: This wall isn't perpendicular to the floor; it looks a little crooked.

告辞.zh: 客人喝完茶，起身向主人告辞。
告辞.en: Having finished his tea, the guest stood up and took his leave of the host.

可观.zh: 这家小店虽然不大，每个月的利润却相当可观。
可观.en: Although this shop is small, its monthly profit is quite considerable.

齐全.zh: 这家医院设备齐全，可以做各种检查。
齐全.en: This hospital is fully equipped and can carry out all kinds of tests.

陶瓷.zh: 这套陶瓷茶具是景德镇生产的。
陶瓷.en: This ceramic tea set was made in Jingdezhen.

诚挚.zh: 我代表全体同学，向远道而来的客人表示诚挚的欢迎。
诚挚.en: On behalf of all the students, I extend a sincere welcome to our guests who have come from afar.

胆怯.zh: 面对那条大狗，小男孩胆怯地躲到了妈妈身后。
胆怯.en: Faced with the big dog, the little boy timidly hid behind his mother.

未免.zh: 只因为一次失败就放弃，未免太可惜了。
未免.en: Giving up after just one failure would be rather a pity.

指南针.zh: 在森林里迷了路，幸好他带着指南针。
指南针.en: He got lost in the forest; luckily he had a compass with him.

巢穴.zh: 那只狐狸叼着食物钻回了自己的巢穴。
巢穴.en: The fox slipped back into its den with food in its mouth.

局部.zh: 这次手术只需要局部麻醉，病人是清醒的。
局部.en: This operation needs only a local anaesthetic; the patient stays awake.

公式.zh: 用这个公式就能算出圆的面积。
公式.en: You can work out the area of a circle with this formula.

雕刻.zh: 这位老艺人能在一粒米上雕刻出一首诗。
雕刻.en: This old craftsman can carve a whole poem onto a single grain of rice.

阶层.zh: 随着经济发展，中等收入阶层在不断扩大。
阶层.en: As the economy develops, the middle-income stratum keeps growing.

规章.zh: 图书馆的规章明确规定，馆内不能大声说话。
规章.en: The library's regulations clearly state that you may not talk loudly inside.

腐朽.zh: 埋在地下多年的木箱早已腐朽不堪。
腐朽.en: The wooden chest, buried underground for years, had long since rotted away.

来历.zh: 这个人来历不明，你最好别轻易相信他。
来历.en: Nobody knows where this man comes from; you'd better not trust him too easily.

搓.zh: 洗衣服时，衣领和袖口要多搓几下。
搓.en: When washing clothes, give the collar and cuffs a few extra rubs.

悬念.zh: 比赛到最后一分钟还充满悬念，谁也不知道哪个队会赢。
悬念.en: The match was full of suspense right up to the last minute; nobody knew which team would win.

寺庙.zh: 每到初一十五，很多老人都会去寺庙烧香。
寺庙.en: On the first and fifteenth of each lunar month, many elderly people go to the temple to burn incense.

公认.zh: 熬夜对健康有害，这是公认的事实。
公认.en: That staying up late harms your health is a universally acknowledged fact.

阻挠.zh: 尽管遇到了种种阻挠，他还是坚持把工厂办了起来。
阻挠.en: Despite all kinds of obstruction, he persisted and got the factory up and running.

间隔.zh: 种树时，每两棵树之间要间隔三米。
间隔.en: When planting, leave a gap of three metres between each pair of trees.

补贴.zh: 政府给购买新能源汽车的人发放补贴。
补贴.en: The government gives subsidies to people who buy new-energy vehicles.

源泉.zh: 对他来说，孩子的笑容就是工作动力的源泉。
源泉.en: For him, his child's smile is the wellspring of his motivation at work.

总而言之.zh: 这家店的菜又贵又难吃，总而言之，下次别去了。
总而言之.en: The food at this place is expensive and awful — in short, let's not go again.

告诫.zh: 医生告诫他必须戒烟，否则病情会加重。
告诫.en: The doctor warned him that he must quit smoking or his condition would get worse.

内涵.zh: 他是一个很有内涵的人，说话总能让人深思。
内涵.en: He is a person of real depth; what he says always makes people think.

交涉.zh: 行李在机场丢了，他跟航空公司交涉了好几次。
交涉.en: His luggage was lost at the airport, and he took the matter up with the airline several times.

课题.zh: 我们小组的研究课题是城市垃圾分类。
课题.en: Our group's research topic is urban waste sorting.

留恋.zh: 假期结束了，孩子们还留恋着在海边玩耍的日子。
留恋.en: The holiday is over, but the children still miss the days of playing by the sea.

牲畜.zh: 草原上的牧民主要靠放养牲畜为生。
牲畜.en: The herders on the grassland make their living mainly by raising livestock.

涮火锅.zh: 四川人涮火锅喜欢放很多辣椒。
涮火锅.en: People in Sichuan like to put lots of chilli in their hot pot.

沉闷.zh: 他性格比较沉闷，不太喜欢和人说话。
沉闷.en: He has a rather withdrawn personality and doesn't much like talking to people.

歪曲.zh: 你不要歪曲我的意思，我根本没那么说。
歪曲.en: Don't twist my meaning; I never said that at all.

慢性.zh: 他患有慢性胃炎，不能吃辣的东西。
慢性.en: He has chronic gastritis and can't eat spicy food.

保养.zh: 她已经五十岁了，但保养得很好，看起来像三十多岁。
保养.en: She's fifty, but she has taken such good care of herself that she looks in her thirties.

调解.zh: 邻居之间的矛盾由社区工作人员出面调解。
调解.en: Disputes between neighbours are mediated by community workers.

衰退.zh: 受疫情影响，全球经济出现了衰退。
衰退.en: Affected by the pandemic, the global economy went into recession.

立体.zh: 这张贺卡打开后，会弹出一座立体的城堡。
立体.en: When you open this card, a three-dimensional castle pops up.

物资.zh: 这次探险需要的物资都已经装上了车。
物资.en: All the supplies needed for this expedition have been loaded onto the truck.

沉思.zh: 老教授听完学生的问题，沉思了片刻才回答。
沉思.en: After hearing the student's question, the old professor pondered for a moment before answering.

档次.zh: 这件衣服的面料很差，一看就没什么档次。
档次.en: The fabric of this garment is poor; you can tell at a glance it's low-grade.

巴不得.zh: 这份工作又累又无聊，他巴不得马上辞职。
巴不得.en: This job is tiring and boring; he can't wait to quit.

半途而废.zh: 他学钢琴学了三个月就半途而废了。
半途而废.en: He studied piano for three months and then gave up halfway.

酝酿.zh: 天空乌云密布，一场暴雨正在酝酿之中。
酝酿.en: The sky is covered in dark clouds; a rainstorm is brewing.

航天.zh: 杨利伟是中国第一位进入太空的航天员。
航天.en: Yang Liwei was China's first astronaut to go into space.

舆论.zh: 在网络时代，舆论的力量越来越大，企业不敢轻易犯错。
舆论.en: In the internet age, public opinion is ever more powerful, and companies dare not slip up lightly.

水龙头.zh: 厨房的水龙头坏了，一直在滴水。
水龙头.en: The kitchen tap is broken and keeps dripping.

株.zh: 这株兰花是爷爷养了十年的宝贝。
株.en: This orchid is a treasure Grandpa has been growing for ten years.

对应.zh: 请把左边的词语和右边对应的解释连起来。
对应.en: Please match the words on the left with the corresponding explanations on the right.

变质.zh: 这些罐头已经过期变质，不能再吃了。
变质.en: These tins are past their date and have gone bad; they can't be eaten.

剥削.zh: 这家工厂让工人每天干十四个小时却只给很少的工资，简直是剥削。
剥削.en: This factory makes workers labour fourteen hours a day for very little pay — it's pure exploitation.

争端.zh: 两家公司因为专利问题发生了争端，最后闹上了法庭。
争端.en: The two companies fell into a dispute over patents that ended up in court.

主流.zh: 电动汽车正在逐渐成为汽车市场的主流。
主流.en: Electric cars are gradually becoming the mainstream of the car market.

跟前.zh: 小狗一听到主人的声音，就跑到他跟前摇尾巴。
跟前.en: As soon as the puppy heard its owner's voice, it ran up to him wagging its tail.

诬陷.zh: 他被同事诬陷泄露了公司机密，最后查明是一场误会。
诬陷.en: A colleague falsely accused him of leaking company secrets; in the end it was found to be a misunderstanding.

编织.zh: 她用彩色的绳子编织了一个漂亮的手链。
编织.en: She wove a pretty bracelet out of coloured string.

桨.zh: 划船比赛中，每个队员都必须跟着鼓声一起划桨。
桨.en: In the boat race, every crew member must pull their oar in time with the drum.

无理取闹.zh: 那位顾客根本没在这家店买过东西，却要求退款，简直是无理取闹。
无理取闹.en: That customer never bought anything at this shop but demanded a refund — just making trouble for no reason.

愣.zh: 老师突然叫他回答问题，他愣了几秒才站起来。
愣.en: When the teacher suddenly called on him, he froze for a few seconds before standing up.

咀嚼.zh: 老师的这句话很有深意，值得我们反复咀嚼。
咀嚼.en: The teacher's remark is very profound and worth pondering over and over.

阻拦.zh: 他决心出国留学，谁也阻拦不了他。
阻拦.en: He is determined to study abroad, and nobody can stop him.

趣味.zh: 这个小游戏既有趣味性又能学到知识。
趣味.en: This little game is both fun and educational.

考古.zh: 这次考古发掘出土了一批珍贵的青铜器。
考古.en: This archaeological dig unearthed a batch of precious bronzes.

敷衍.zh: 我问他为什么迟到，他只是随便敷衍了几句。
敷衍.en: When I asked him why he was late, he just fobbed me off with a few words.

捆绑.zh: 超市把牙膏和牙刷捆绑在一起销售。
捆绑.en: The supermarket sells toothpaste and toothbrushes bundled together.

报销.zh: 看病的费用有一部分可以用医疗保险报销。
报销.en: Part of the cost of seeing a doctor can be reimbursed through medical insurance.

截止.zh: 这次征文比赛的截止日期是下个月十号。
截止.en: The deadline for this essay competition is the tenth of next month.

弥漫.zh: 清晨，整个山谷弥漫着浓浓的雾气。
弥漫.en: In the early morning, thick mist fills the whole valley.

广阔.zh: 飞机下面是一片广阔的草原。
广阔.en: Below the plane lies a vast grassland.

容貌.zh: 这位演员的容貌几十年来几乎没有变化。
容貌.en: This actor's looks have hardly changed in decades.

容纳.zh: 这个会议室最多能容纳三十个人。
容纳.en: This meeting room can hold at most thirty people.

天然气.zh: 冬天一到，天然气的用量就大幅增加。
天然气.en: As soon as winter arrives, natural gas consumption rises sharply.

租赁.zh: 这家公司的办公楼是租赁的，每年要付很高的租金。
租赁.en: This company's office building is leased, and it pays a high rent every year.

破例.zh: 博物馆平时周一闭馆，今天为了这批学生破例开放。
破例.en: The museum is normally closed on Mondays, but today it made an exception and opened for these students.

生机.zh: 一场春雨过后，干枯的草地重新恢复了生机。
生机.en: After a spring rain, the withered grass came back to life.

名副其实.zh: 这里的冬天零下四十度，是名副其实的“冰城”。
名副其实.en: Winters here reach forty below zero; it truly lives up to the name "Ice City".

传授.zh: 这位冠军经常向年轻选手传授比赛经验。
传授.en: This champion often passes on his competition experience to young players.

闲话.zh: 闲话少说，我们开始上课吧。
闲话.en: Enough idle chat — let's start the lesson.

连同.zh: 他把钱包连同里面的证件一起弄丢了。
连同.en: He lost his wallet along with the documents in it.

正宗.zh: 想吃正宗的川菜，就得去成都。
正宗.en: If you want authentic Sichuan food, you have to go to Chengdu.

拘束.zh: 第一次去女朋友家吃饭，他显得很拘束。
拘束.en: The first time he went to his girlfriend's home for dinner, he seemed very ill at ease.

局限.zh: 这项研究的样本太少，结论存在一定的局限性。
局限.en: This study's sample is too small, so its conclusions have certain limitations.

就业.zh: 这个新工厂建成后，可以为当地提供两千个就业机会。
就业.en: Once completed, this new factory can provide two thousand local jobs.

宗旨.zh: 这家慈善机构的宗旨是帮助贫困地区的儿童上学。
宗旨.en: This charity's purpose is to help children in poor areas go to school.

响应.zh: 我在群里提议周末去爬山，大家纷纷响应。
响应.en: I suggested a weekend hike in the group chat, and everyone responded enthusiastically.

和睦.zh: 邻里之间应该和睦相处，互相帮助。
和睦.en: Neighbours should live in harmony and help one another.

候选.zh: 班长选举有四名候选人，最后小李当选了。
候选.en: There were four candidates in the class monitor election, and Xiao Li won in the end.

上游.zh: 他的成绩在班里一直处于上游水平。
上游.en: His grades have always been near the top of the class.

窍门.zh: 我教你一个去除衣服上油渍的小窍门。
窍门.en: Let me teach you a little trick for getting grease stains out of clothes.

晴朗.zh: 晴朗的夜晚，在郊外可以看到满天的星星。
晴朗.en: On a clear night, you can see a sky full of stars out in the countryside.

抱负.zh: 他从小就立下了远大的抱负，要当一名科学家。
抱负.en: From childhood he set himself the lofty ambition of becoming a scientist.

开朗.zh: 走出山洞，眼前豁然开朗，出现了一片美丽的湖泊。
开朗.en: Coming out of the cave, the view suddenly opened up to reveal a beautiful lake.

干劲.zh: 听说完成任务有奖金，大家的干劲更足了。
干劲.en: Hearing there was a bonus for finishing the task, everyone worked with even more drive.

口腔.zh: 他去医院看牙，挂了口腔科的号。
口腔.en: He went to the hospital about his teeth and registered with the dental department.

凝固.zh: 汤放凉以后，表面的油就凝固成了白色的一层。
凝固.en: Once the soup cooled, the fat on top congealed into a white layer.

停顿.zh: 他说到这里停顿了一下，好像在想该怎么说。
停顿.en: He paused at this point, as if thinking about how to put it.

专程.zh: 为了吃一碗正宗的牛肉面，她专程去了一趟兰州。
专程.en: She made a special trip to Lanzhou just to eat a bowl of authentic beef noodles.

贪污.zh: 公司的会计贪污了几十万元公款，被公司开除了。
贪污.en: The company accountant embezzled several hundred thousand yuan of company funds and was fired.

缠绕.zh: 耳机线在包里缠绕成一团，很难解开。
缠绕.en: The earphone cable got tangled into a ball in the bag and was hard to undo.

福气.zh: 能遇到这么好的老师，是我们的福气。
福气.en: It's our good fortune to have met such a good teacher.

溶解.zh: 这种药片放进水里，几秒钟就完全溶解了。
溶解.en: Put this tablet in water and it dissolves completely in a few seconds.

更正.zh: 我刚才说错了一个数字，现在更正一下。
更正.en: I got a number wrong just now; let me correct it.

日益.zh: 随着网购的发展，快递行业日益繁忙。
日益.en: With the growth of online shopping, the courier industry is getting busier by the day.

传记.zh: 这部电影是根据一位科学家的传记改编的。
传记.en: This film is adapted from the biography of a scientist.

缓和.zh: 听了我的解释，她的语气才缓和下来。
缓和.en: Only after hearing my explanation did her tone soften.

秃.zh: 这支毛笔用了太久，笔尖都秃了。
秃.en: This brush has been used so long that its tip has worn bare.

盈利.zh: 这家餐厅开业三年，终于开始盈利了。
盈利.en: Three years after opening, this restaurant has finally started making a profit.

对称.zh: 仔细看会发现，蝴蝶的两只翅膀是完全对称的。
对称.en: Look closely and you'll see a butterfly's two wings are perfectly symmetrical.

叹气.zh: 别总是唉声叹气的，问题总会解决的。
叹气.en: Stop sighing all the time; the problem will get solved.

力所能及.zh: 我们应该在力所能及的范围内帮助有困难的人。
力所能及.en: We should help people in difficulty as far as it is within our power.

从容.zh: 离出发还有两个小时，时间很从容，不用着急。
从容.en: There are still two hours before we leave; there's plenty of time, no need to rush.

独裁.zh: 这个老板作风独裁，从来不听员工的意见。
独裁.en: This boss has an autocratic style and never listens to his employees' opinions.

沉着.zh: 守门员沉着应对，扑出了对方的点球。
沉着.en: The goalkeeper stayed cool-headed and saved the opponents' penalty.

暧昧.zh: 他俩的关系有点暧昧，大家都在猜他们是不是在谈恋爱。
暧昧.en: Their relationship is a bit ambiguous; everyone is guessing whether they're dating.

惋惜.zh: 这么有才华的画家早早就放弃了画画，真让人惋惜。
惋惜.en: It's a real pity that such a talented painter gave up painting so early.

开采.zh: 这片海域下面有大量石油，但开采难度很大。
开采.en: There is a lot of oil under these waters, but extracting it is very difficult.

优越.zh: 他家里条件优越，从小就没吃过什么苦。
优越.en: His family is well off, so he has never known hardship since childhood.

鲜明.zh: 这两个人的性格形成了鲜明的对比。
鲜明.en: The two people's personalities form a sharp contrast.

条理.zh: 这篇作文条理清楚，层次分明。
条理.en: This essay is clearly organised and well structured.

文雅.zh: 这个名字听起来很文雅，有一种书卷气。
文雅.en: This name sounds very refined, with a scholarly air.

包庇.zh: 班长包庇自己的好朋友，没有把他迟到的事报告老师。
包庇.en: The class monitor covered for his good friend and didn't report his lateness to the teacher.

直径.zh: 这棵老树的树干直径超过一米，需要三个人才能抱住。
直径.en: This old tree's trunk is over a metre in diameter; it takes three people to put their arms around it.

狭窄.zh: 他心胸狭窄，别人说一句不好听的话他就记很久。
狭窄.en: He is narrow-minded; if someone says one unkind word he remembers it for ages.

滋润.zh: 一场春雨滋润了干旱的土地。
滋润.en: A spring rain moistened the parched land.

昔日.zh: 昔日的同学如今都成了各行各业的骨干。
昔日.en: My former classmates have now all become mainstays in their various fields.

成效.zh: 这项改革已初见成效，市民看病比以前方便多了。
成效.en: The reform is already showing results; it's much easier for residents to see a doctor than before.

性能.zh: 这辆跑车的性能非常出色，几秒钟就能加速到一百公里。
性能.en: This sports car performs superbly; it can reach a hundred kilometres an hour in seconds.

心甘情愿.zh: 只要能和喜欢的人在一起，吃再多苦他也心甘情愿。
心甘情愿.en: As long as he can be with the person he loves, he's perfectly willing to endure any hardship.

吝啬.zh: 他对自己很大方，对别人却非常吝啬。
吝啬.en: He's generous to himself but very stingy with others.

要素.zh: 资金、技术和人才是企业发展的三大要素。
要素.en: Capital, technology and talent are the three key elements of a company's growth.

无忧无虑.zh: 小狗在草地上无忧无虑地跑来跑去。
无忧无虑.en: The puppy ran back and forth on the grass without a care in the world.

拼搏.zh: 运动员们在赛场上奋力拼搏，赢得了观众的掌声。
拼搏.en: The athletes gave their all on the field and won the crowd's applause.

庄重.zh: 他平时爱开玩笑，可一上讲台就变得很庄重。
庄重.en: He usually loves to joke, but once he steps onto the podium he becomes very serious.

宏伟.zh: 这座新建的体育馆规模宏伟，可以同时举办好几场比赛。
宏伟.en: This newly built stadium is on a grand scale and can host several events at once.

孕育.zh: 这片热带雨林孕育了成千上万种动植物。
孕育.en: This tropical rainforest has nurtured tens of thousands of species of plants and animals.

奔波.zh: 为了给女儿治病，他四处奔波借钱。
奔波.en: To pay for his daughter's treatment, he rushed about everywhere borrowing money.

向来.zh: 我向来不喜欢吃甜食，你别给我买蛋糕了。
向来.en: I've never liked sweet things, so don't buy me a cake.

勇于.zh: 优秀的企业家都勇于尝试新事物。
勇于.en: Great entrepreneurs all have the courage to try new things.

一帆风顺.zh: 创业的路不可能一帆风顺，总会遇到各种困难。
一帆风顺.en: Starting a business is never plain sailing; you'll always run into difficulties.

陈旧.zh: 这本教材的内容太陈旧了，很多知识已经过时。
陈旧.en: This textbook's content is too old; a lot of the knowledge is out of date.

茫茫.zh: 在茫茫人海中，我们能够相遇真是缘分。
茫茫.en: That we met in this vast sea of people really is fate.

绣.zh: 这条丝巾上绣着几只蝴蝶，非常精致。
绣.en: This silk scarf is embroidered with a few butterflies and is very exquisite.

细致.zh: 这位医生检查得很细致，连很小的问题都没放过。
细致.en: This doctor examined me very meticulously and didn't miss even the smallest problem.

田野.zh: 火车飞驰而过，窗外是一望无际的金色田野。
田野.en: The train sped along; outside the window stretched endless golden fields.

摧残.zh: 一场冰雹把果园里刚开的花摧残得七零八落。
摧残.en: A hailstorm ravaged the orchard's newly opened blossoms, leaving them in tatters.

事项.zh: 考试开始前，监考老师宣读了注意事项。
事项.en: Before the exam began, the invigilator read out the points to note.

运算.zh: 小学生要先学会加减乘除四则运算。
运算.en: Primary pupils first need to learn the four operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication and division.

牢骚.zh: 他对新的考勤制度满腹牢骚。
牢骚.en: He is full of complaints about the new attendance system.

攀登.zh: 这位登山家曾三次攀登珠穆朗玛峰。
攀登.en: This mountaineer has climbed Mount Everest three times.

岳母.zh: 结婚以后，他和岳母相处得很好，像母子一样。
岳母.en: Since marrying, he has got on very well with his mother-in-law, like mother and son.

动员.zh: 社区动员居民们参加垃圾分类活动。
动员.en: The neighbourhood is mobilising residents to take part in waste sorting.

凝聚.zh: 一场比赛的胜利，让整个班级的凝聚力更强了。
凝聚.en: Winning a match made the whole class more cohesive.

节制.zh: 喝酒要有节制，喝多了伤身体。
节制.en: Drink in moderation; drinking too much harms your health.

流通.zh: 这种旧版纸币已经停止流通了。
流通.en: This old banknote is no longer in circulation.

次序.zh: 这些文件被打乱了次序，你帮我重新排一下。
次序.en: These documents have got out of order; please help me rearrange them.

批判.zh: 这位哲学家批判了当时流行的一些错误思想。
批判.en: This philosopher critiqued some of the mistaken ideas popular at the time.

急躁.zh: 学书法不能急躁，要一笔一画慢慢练。
急躁.en: You can't be impatient learning calligraphy; you have to practise stroke by stroke.

思索.zh: 他不假思索地回答了老师的问题。
思索.en: He answered the teacher's question without a moment's thought.

尖端.zh: 这家医院拥有很多尖端的医疗设备。
尖端.en: This hospital has a lot of cutting-edge medical equipment.

夕阳.zh: 夕阳西下，渔船一艘艘回到了港口。
夕阳.en: As the sun set, the fishing boats returned to harbour one after another.

复兴.zh: 欧洲的文艺复兴对世界文化产生了深远的影响。
复兴.en: The European Renaissance had a profound influence on world culture.

体积.zh: 这个箱子体积太大，放不进汽车的后备箱。
体积.en: This box is too bulky to fit in the car boot.

谦逊.zh: 获奖后，他谦逊地说这是团队共同努力的结果。
谦逊.en: After winning the award, he modestly said it was the result of the whole team's effort.

缺口.zh: 这只碗边上有个缺口，小心别划破手。
缺口.en: This bowl has a chip in its rim; be careful not to cut your hand.

现成.zh: 你别自己做了，超市里有现成的饺子卖。
现成.en: Don't make them yourself; the supermarket sells ready-made dumplings.

率领.zh: 主教练率领球队来到北京参加比赛。
率领.en: The head coach led the team to Beijing for the competition.

无非.zh: 他每天的生活无非是上班、吃饭、睡觉。
无非.en: His daily life is nothing but work, eating and sleeping.

才干.zh: 新来的经理很有才干，公司业绩明显提高了。
才干.en: The new manager is very capable, and the company's results have clearly improved.

愚昧.zh: 古时候人们因为愚昧，把生病当成是鬼神在作怪。
愚昧.en: In ancient times, out of ignorance, people thought illness was the work of ghosts and spirits.

展望.zh: 在毕业典礼上，校长回顾了过去，也展望了未来。
展望.en: At the graduation ceremony, the principal reviewed the past and looked ahead to the future.

屏障.zh: 这排大树就像一道屏障，挡住了冬天的寒风。
屏障.en: This row of big trees acts like a barrier, blocking the cold winter wind.

嫂子.zh: 哥哥和嫂子结婚五年了，感情一直很好。
嫂子.en: My brother and his wife have been married five years and are still very close.

发炎.zh: 他的嗓子发炎了，说话声音都哑了。
发炎.en: His throat is inflamed, and his voice has gone hoarse.

乐谱.zh: 这位钢琴家演出时从来不看乐谱，全靠记忆。
乐谱.en: This pianist never looks at sheet music when performing; it's all from memory.

迟疑.zh: 接到这份工作邀请，她毫不迟疑地答应了。
迟疑.en: When she got this job offer, she accepted without the slightest hesitation.

迁徙.zh: 每年夏天，数百万头角马会穿过草原进行大迁徙。
迁徙.en: Every summer, millions of wildebeest cross the grasslands in a great migration.

茫然.zh: 被问到将来想做什么，他一脸茫然，答不上来。
茫然.en: Asked what he wanted to do in future, he looked blank and couldn't answer.

滔滔不绝.zh: 导游滔滔不绝地向游客介绍这座古城的历史。
滔滔不绝.en: The guide talked on and on to the tourists about the history of the ancient city.

曲折.zh: 这部小说的情节曲折，让人猜不到结局。
曲折.en: This novel's plot is full of twists, so you can't guess the ending.

惊动.zh: 这点小病，就不用惊动全家人了。
惊动.en: It's only a minor illness; no need to alarm the whole family.

压缩.zh: 他把这些照片压缩成一个文件，发到了我的邮箱。
压缩.en: He compressed these photos into one file and sent it to my email.

觉醒.zh: 这本书让很多女性的独立意识开始觉醒。
觉醒.en: This book awakened a sense of independence in many women.

索取.zh: 他总是向朋友索取帮助，却从来不回报。
索取.en: He is always asking friends for help but never gives anything back.

示意.zh: 司机挥挥手，示意我们先过马路。
示意.en: The driver waved, signalling us to cross the road first.

深沉.zh: 他的声音深沉而有磁性，很适合做播音员。
深沉.en: His voice is deep and magnetic, ideal for a broadcaster.

巩固.zh: 这场胜利巩固了他们在联赛中第一名的位置。
巩固.en: This win consolidated their first place in the league.

阐述.zh: 请你简单阐述一下这个方案的主要内容。
阐述.en: Please briefly set out the main points of this plan.

适宜.zh: 这种花不适宜放在阳光直射的地方。
适宜.en: This flower isn't suited to being placed in direct sunlight.

过问.zh: 公司的事情父亲从来不过问，全交给了哥哥。
过问.en: Father never gets involved in company matters; he has handed everything to my brother.

败坏.zh: 抄袭现象如果不制止，会败坏整个学术风气。
败坏.en: If plagiarism isn't stopped, it will corrupt the whole academic culture.

请帖.zh: 婚礼前一个月，他们就开始给亲戚朋友发请帖了。
请帖.en: A month before the wedding, they started sending invitations to relatives and friends.

耗费.zh: 装修这套房子耗费了他们全部的积蓄。
耗费.en: Renovating this flat used up all their savings.

泛滥.zh: 雨下了一个星期，河水泛滥，淹没了附近的农田。
泛滥.en: After a week of rain the river overflowed and flooded the nearby farmland.

方言.zh: 他说的是上海方言，外地人很难听懂。
方言.en: He speaks the Shanghai dialect, which outsiders find hard to understand.

培育.zh: 学校的任务是培育德智体全面发展的人才。
培育.en: A school's task is to nurture well-rounded people, morally, intellectually and physically.

停滞.zh: 因为疫情，这座城市的旅游业几乎陷入停滞。
停滞.en: Because of the pandemic, the city's tourism industry almost came to a standstill.

严禁.zh: 图书馆内严禁饮食和大声喧哗。
严禁.en: Eating, drinking and loud noise are strictly prohibited in the library.

转折.zh: 电影的结尾有一个出人意料的转折。
转折.en: The film's ending has an unexpected twist.

表彰.zh: 这位司机因为救了落水的孩子，受到了市政府的表彰。
表彰.en: The driver was commended by the city government for rescuing a child who fell into the water.

若干.zh: 这篇文章存在若干问题，需要进一步修改。
若干.en: This article has several problems and needs further revision.

牵制.zh: 我们派两名队员牵制对方的主力，其他人负责进攻。
牵制.en: We'll send two players to tie down their key player while the rest attack.

焦急.zh: 航班一再推迟，乘客们焦急地在候机厅里等待。
焦急.en: The flight was delayed again and again, and passengers waited anxiously in the departure lounge.

炎热.zh: 在炎热的夏天，人们都喜欢去游泳。
炎热.en: In the sweltering summer, everyone likes to go swimming.

权衡.zh: 买房还是租房，需要好好权衡一下。
权衡.en: Whether to buy or rent needs careful weighing up.

插座.zh: 这个插座坏了，电脑没法充电。
插座.en: This socket is broken, so the computer can't charge.

打量.zh: 店员用怀疑的眼光打量着这位穿着破旧的顾客。
打量.en: The shop assistant looked the shabbily dressed customer up and down with suspicion.

应酬.zh: 他不喜欢喝酒，所以很怕这种饭局上的应酬。
应酬.en: He doesn't like drinking, so he dreads the socialising at these business dinners.

奥秘.zh: 这本科普书为孩子们揭开了海洋的奥秘。
奥秘.en: This popular-science book reveals the mysteries of the ocean to children.

响亮.zh: 这家公司的名字很响亮，大家一听就记住了。
响亮.en: This company's name is so resounding that everyone remembers it straight away.

划分.zh: 这座城市被划分为东、西两个区。
划分.en: The city is divided into two districts, east and west.

附属.zh: 他毕业于北京大学附属中学。
附属.en: He graduated from the high school affiliated with Peking University.

自卑.zh: 你不要因为家里穷就自卑，靠自己努力一样能成功。
自卑.en: Don't feel inferior because your family is poor; you can succeed through your own efforts.

背诵.zh: 演讲比赛前，她把稿子背诵得滚瓜烂熟。
背诵.en: Before the speech contest, she had memorised her script word-perfectly.

盛开.zh: 五月，山坡上的杜鹃花盛开了，一片火红。
盛开.en: In May the azaleas on the hillside are in full bloom, a sea of fiery red.

汹涌.zh: 台风来了，海面上波涛汹涌，渔船都回港了。
汹涌.en: The typhoon has arrived; the sea is surging, and the fishing boats have all returned to port.

毅力.zh: 他十年来每天坚持跑步五公里，从未间断，真有毅力。
毅力.en: He has run five kilometres every day for ten years without a break — real perseverance.

敬业.zh: 这位快递员非常敬业，下大雨也准时把包裹送到。
敬业.en: This courier is very dedicated; he delivers parcels on time even in heavy rain.

拔苗助长.zh: 让三岁的孩子每天学五个小时数学，简直是拔苗助长。
拔苗助长.en: Making a three-year-old study maths five hours a day is just spoiling things by pushing too hard.

当务之急.zh: 公司的现金快用完了，当务之急是找到新的投资。
当务之急.en: The company is nearly out of cash; the top priority is to find new investment.

对立.zh: 黑与白、冷与热都是对立的概念。
对立.en: Black and white, hot and cold are opposite concepts.

增添.zh: 节日的彩灯为街道增添了几分喜庆的气氛。
增添.en: The festive lights add a joyful atmosphere to the streets.

隔阂.zh: 因为一次误会，两个老朋友之间产生了隔阂。
隔阂.en: Because of a misunderstanding, a rift grew between the two old friends.

譬如.zh: 学外语有很多方法，譬如看电影、听歌、和外国人聊天。
譬如.en: There are many ways to learn a foreign language, for example watching films, listening to songs and chatting with foreigners.

腹泻.zh: 小孩子吃了太多冰淇淋，容易腹泻。
腹泻.en: Young children who eat too much ice cream easily get diarrhoea.

指标.zh: 体检报告显示，他的血糖指标偏高。
指标.en: His medical report shows his blood sugar reading is on the high side.

庸俗.zh: 有些广告为了吸引眼球，内容越来越庸俗。
庸俗.en: To grab attention, some adverts are getting more and more vulgar.

妥善.zh: 公司妥善处理了顾客的投诉，顾客很满意。
妥善.en: The company handled the customer's complaint properly, and the customer was very satisfied.

坚实.zh: 这座房子建在坚实的岩石上，非常安全。
坚实.en: This house is built on solid rock and is very safe.

启事.zh: 公司在网站上发布了一则招聘启事。
启事.en: The company posted a recruitment notice on its website.

后勤.zh: 比赛期间，后勤人员负责给运动员准备饮食。
后勤.en: During the competition, the support staff prepare meals for the athletes.

面貌.zh: 毕业二十年，同学们的精神面貌都变了不少。
面貌.en: Twenty years after graduating, my classmates' outlook and spirit have all changed quite a bit.

雌雄.zh: 两支球队将在决赛中一决雌雄。
雌雄.en: The two teams will fight it out for victory in the final.

重叠.zh: 这两张照片重叠在一起，看起来有点奇怪。
重叠.en: These two photos overlap, and it looks a bit strange.

相差.zh: 这两件衣服看起来差不多，价格却相差一倍。
相差.en: These two garments look much the same, yet one costs twice as much as the other.

深奥.zh: 爷爷用简单的例子给我讲了一个深奥的哲学道理。
深奥.en: Grandpa used a simple example to explain a profound philosophical idea to me.

周密.zh: 这次活动安排得十分周密，没有出现任何问题。
周密.en: This event was very thoroughly organised, and nothing went wrong.

凶恶.zh: 童话里的大灰狼总是长着一副凶恶的样子。
凶恶.en: The big bad wolf in fairy tales always looks ferocious.

铸造.zh: 这家工厂专门铸造汽车发动机的零件。
铸造.en: This factory specialises in casting parts for car engines.

枯萎.zh: 秋天一到，路边的野草就慢慢枯萎了。
枯萎.en: As soon as autumn comes, the wild grass by the road slowly withers.

投掷.zh: 请不要向动物投掷食物，以免影响它们的健康。
投掷.en: Please don't throw food to the animals, as it can harm their health.

急剧.zh: 这几年，城市人口急剧增加，住房越来越紧张。
急剧.en: In recent years the city's population has risen sharply, and housing is getting tighter.

出息.zh: 他从小就很懂事，长大以后果然很有出息。
出息.en: He was sensible from a young age, and sure enough he made something of himself when he grew up.

优异.zh: 这款新手机在测试中表现优异。
优异.en: This new phone performed outstandingly in testing.

专题.zh: 下周的班会将围绕“网络安全”开展专题讨论。
专题.en: Next week's class meeting will hold a discussion on the special topic of online safety.

鼓动.zh: 有人在网上鼓动大家抢购食盐，结果造成了混乱。
鼓动.en: Someone online stirred people up to panic-buy salt, which caused chaos.

雪上加霜.zh: 本来就迟到了，车又在半路上坏了，真是雪上加霜。
雪上加霜.en: I was already late, and then the car broke down halfway — it just made things worse.

转让.zh: 他把自己的专利转让给了一家大公司。
转让.en: He transferred his patent to a large company.

范畴.zh: 心理学属于社会科学的范畴吗？
范畴.en: Does psychology fall within the domain of the social sciences?

致辞.zh: 婚礼上，新娘的父亲上台致辞，感动了所有的客人。
致辞.en: At the wedding, the bride's father went up to give a speech that moved all the guests.

田径.zh: 这所大学的田径队在全国比赛中获得了好几块金牌。
田径.en: This university's athletics team won several gold medals in the national competition.

摸索.zh: 停电了，他在黑暗中摸索着找到了蜡烛。
摸索.en: When the power went out, he groped around in the dark and found a candle.

排放.zh: 汽车尾气的排放是城市空气污染的主要原因之一。
排放.en: Car exhaust emissions are one of the main causes of urban air pollution.

固体.zh: 黄油在冰箱里是固体，加热后就变成了液体。
固体.en: Butter is solid in the fridge but turns liquid when heated.

伯母.zh: 我小时候常去伯母家玩，她总是给我做好吃的。
伯母.en: As a child I often went to my aunt's house, and she always cooked me something tasty.

饲养.zh: 这个动物园饲养着两只大熊猫。
饲养.en: This zoo keeps two giant pandas.

迁就.zh: 夫妻之间要互相迁就，才能长久地相处下去。
迁就.en: Husband and wife must accommodate each other if they are to get along for the long term.

轮船.zh: 在没有飞机的年代，人们只能坐轮船出国。
轮船.en: In the days before aeroplanes, people could only go abroad by steamship.

解体.zh: 那艘旧船在暴风雨中解体，沉入了海底。
解体.en: That old ship broke apart in the storm and sank to the seabed.

舟.zh: 在古代，人们靠一叶小舟渡过这条大河。
舟.en: In ancient times, people crossed this great river in a small boat.

腥.zh: 做鱼的时候放点姜和料酒，可以去腥。
腥.en: When cooking fish, add some ginger and cooking wine to get rid of the fishy taste.

改良.zh: 经过改良，这款电饭锅煮出来的米饭更香了。
改良.en: After being improved, this rice cooker makes even more fragrant rice.

布局.zh: 这篇作文的布局很巧妙，开头和结尾互相呼应。
布局.en: This essay is cleverly structured, with the beginning and the end echoing each other.

博览会.zh: 2010年，上海成功举办了世界博览会。
博览会.en: In 2010 Shanghai successfully hosted the World Expo.

勤劳.zh: 她是个勤劳的农家姑娘，每天天不亮就下地干活。
勤劳.en: She is a hardworking farm girl who goes to work in the fields before dawn every day.

利害.zh: 他和这家公司没有任何利害关系，所以他的评价比较客观。
利害.en: He has no stake in this company, so his assessment is fairly objective.

作废.zh: 合同上的名字写错了，只好作废重签。
作废.en: The name on the contract was written wrong, so it had to be voided and signed again.

阵容.zh: 这支球队今年引进了几名球星，阵容更加强大了。
阵容.en: This team signed several star players this year, so its line-up is even stronger.

规格.zh: 这次接待外宾的规格非常高。
规格.en: The reception for these foreign guests was held to a very high standard.

统筹兼顾.zh: 安排时间要统筹兼顾，工作和家庭都不能忽视。
统筹兼顾.en: When planning your time, take everything into account; neither work nor family can be neglected.

简陋.zh: 他们住在一间简陋的小木屋里，连电都没有。
简陋.en: They live in a crude little wooden hut that doesn't even have electricity.

简化.zh: 汉字简化以后，学习起来容易多了。
简化.en: Since Chinese characters were simplified, they have become much easier to learn.

果断.zh: 看到孩子掉进水里，他果断地跳下去把孩子救了上来。
果断.en: Seeing the child fall into the water, he decisively jumped in and pulled the child out.

提炼.zh: 写总结时，要从大量材料中提炼出最重要的观点。
提炼.en: When writing a summary, you need to distil the key points from a mass of material.

唯独.zh: 他什么菜都吃，唯独不吃香菜。
唯独.en: He eats every kind of dish, except coriander.

反思.zh: 这次事故值得每个人认真反思。
反思.en: This accident deserves serious reflection from everyone.

不像话.zh: 这家饭店让客人等了两个小时才上菜，真不像话。
不像话.en: This restaurant made its guests wait two hours for their food — outrageous.

附件.zh: 我把简历放在附件里了，请查收。
附件.en: I've put my CV in the attachment; please check it.

里程碑.zh: 第一次登上月球是人类探索太空的里程碑。
里程碑.en: The first moon landing was a milestone in humanity's exploration of space.

荒凉.zh: 沙漠里一片荒凉，几十公里都看不到一个人。
荒凉.en: The desert is utterly desolate; you can go dozens of kilometres without seeing anyone.

致使.zh: 由于司机疲劳驾驶，致使两辆车相撞。
致使.en: Because a driver was driving while exhausted, two cars collided.

筐.zh: 农民挑着两筐白菜到集市上去卖。
筐.en: The farmer carried two baskets of cabbages on a shoulder pole to sell at the market.

空想.zh: 你的计划只是空想，根本没有实现的可能。
空想.en: Your plan is pure fantasy; there's no chance of it ever happening.

狼狈.zh: 他在台上摔了一跤，样子狼狈极了。
狼狈.en: He tripped and fell on stage and looked utterly embarrassed.

清澈.zh: 她有一双清澈的大眼睛，像山里的泉水。
清澈.en: She has large, clear eyes, like a mountain spring.

格式.zh: 这个文件的格式不对，电脑打不开。
格式.en: This file is in the wrong format, so the computer can't open it.

方针.zh: 学校坚持“因材施教”的教学方针。
方针.en: The school sticks to the guiding principle of teaching each student according to their aptitude.

投机.zh: 他买房子不是为了住，而是为了投机赚钱。
投机.en: He didn't buy the house to live in, but to speculate and make money.

干旱.zh: 这种植物非常耐干旱，在沙漠里也能生长。
干旱.en: This plant is very drought-resistant and can grow even in the desert.

地质.zh: 地质专家正在研究这一带为什么经常发生滑坡。
地质.en: Geology experts are studying why landslides happen so often in this area.

团圆.zh: 在外地工作的哥哥今年终于能回家过年，全家团圆了。
团圆.en: My brother, who works far away, can finally come home for New Year, so the whole family is reunited.

嘈杂.zh: 这家咖啡馆环境嘈杂，根本没法安心看书。
嘈杂.en: This café is so noisy that it's impossible to read in peace.

号召.zh: 在班长的号召下，同学们纷纷为生病的同学捐款。
号召.en: Answering the class monitor's call, the students donated money for their sick classmate.

发呆.zh: 上课时别发呆，要认真听老师讲。
发呆.en: Don't space out in class; listen carefully to the teacher.

分红.zh: 这家合作社今年效益好，年底给每户村民分红五千元。
分红.en: This cooperative did well this year and paid each village household a dividend of five thousand yuan at year end.

凄凉.zh: 秋风吹过，满地落叶，景色显得格外凄凉。
凄凉.en: The autumn wind blows and fallen leaves cover the ground; the scene looks especially dreary.

颁布.zh: 教育部颁布了新的中小学生作业管理规定。
颁布.en: The Ministry of Education has issued new rules on managing homework for school pupils.

爽快.zh: 他是个爽快人，说话从不拐弯抹角。
爽快.en: He's a straightforward person who never beats about the bush.

无精打采.zh: 那盆花几天没浇水，叶子无精打采地垂着。
无精打采.en: That pot plant hasn't been watered for days, and its leaves are drooping listlessly.

参照.zh: 这次比赛的评分标准参照了国际通行的做法。
参照.en: The scoring criteria for this competition took international practice as a reference.

化石.zh: 这块石头里有一条鱼的化石，已经有几百万年了。
化石.en: This stone contains the fossil of a fish that is millions of years old.

切实.zh: 学校要切实减轻学生的课业负担。
切实.en: Schools must genuinely reduce students' workload.

丰收.zh: 果农们望着满树的苹果，脸上露出了丰收的喜悦。
丰收.en: Looking at the trees laden with apples, the fruit farmers beamed with the joy of a bumper harvest.

配套.zh: 新买的电脑还送了一套配套的鼠标和键盘。
配套.en: The new computer came with a matching mouse and keyboard.

逝世.zh: 鲁迅逝世于一九三六年，享年五十五岁。
逝世.en: Lu Xun passed away in 1936 at the age of fifty-five.

迸发.zh: 在灵感迸发的那一刻，他马上拿起笔写了下来。
迸发.en: The moment inspiration burst forth, he immediately picked up a pen and wrote it down.

董事长.zh: 这家公司的董事长今年才三十五岁。
董事长.en: The chairman of this company's board is only thirty-five this year.

英明.zh: 当年选择在这里建厂，真是一个英明的决定。
英明.en: Choosing to build the factory here back then was a truly wise decision.

简要.zh: 会议记录只需要简要写下主要内容就行了。
简要.en: The minutes only need to briefly record the main points.

秤.zh: 这家水果店的秤不准，顾客经常吃亏。
秤.en: This fruit shop's scale is inaccurate, so customers often lose out.

整顿.zh: 这家餐厅卫生不合格，被要求停业整顿。
整顿.en: This restaurant failed its hygiene inspection and was ordered to close and reorganise.

抹杀.zh: 历史事实是任何人都抹杀不了的。
抹杀.en: Historical facts are something no one can erase.

总和.zh: 这三个数字的总和正好是一百。
总和.en: The sum of these three numbers is exactly one hundred.

开明.zh: 这位老板很开明，允许员工每周在家工作两天。
开明.en: This boss is very open-minded and lets staff work from home two days a week.

幅度.zh: 这次考试，他的成绩提高的幅度最大。
幅度.en: In this exam, his marks improved by the greatest margin.

威风.zh: 穿上新队服，队员们一个个威风凛凛。
威风.en: In their new team kit, the players all looked imposing.

压榨.zh: 这家公司长期压榨员工，让他们免费加班。
压榨.en: This company has long squeezed its employees, making them work overtime for free.

修养.zh: 弹钢琴可以提高一个人的艺术修养。
修养.en: Playing the piano can raise a person's artistic cultivation.

隐患.zh: 电线老化是引起火灾的一大隐患。
隐患.en: Ageing wiring is a major hidden danger that can cause fires.

真挚.zh: 他在信中表达了对老师真挚的感谢。
真挚.en: In his letter he expressed his sincere thanks to his teacher.

申报.zh: 每年三月，个人需要申报上一年的收入。
申报.en: Every March, individuals must declare their income for the previous year.

狭隘.zh: 他的知识面太狭隘，只了解自己专业的东西。
狭隘.en: His knowledge is too narrow; he only knows about his own field.

本钱.zh: 做生意需要本钱，他只好先向亲戚借了一些。
本钱.en: Doing business needs capital, so he had to borrow some from relatives first.

垄断.zh: 为了防止垄断，政府鼓励更多企业进入这个行业。
垄断.en: To prevent monopoly, the government encourages more companies to enter this industry.

功效.zh: 这种草药有清热解毒的功效。
功效.en: This herb has the effect of clearing heat and removing toxins.

虚荣.zh: 他为了虚荣，借钱买了一辆豪车。
虚荣.en: Out of vanity, he borrowed money to buy a luxury car.

结算.zh: 住酒店时，可以在退房时一起结算费用。
结算.en: When staying at a hotel, you can settle the bill all at once when you check out.

滞留.zh: 台风来袭，大批游客滞留在岛上无法离开。
滞留.en: When the typhoon struck, large numbers of tourists were stranded on the island and couldn't leave.

治理.zh: 经过多年治理，这条臭水沟变成了美丽的小河。
治理.en: After years of clean-up work, this smelly ditch has become a beautiful stream.

柴油.zh: 这台发电机烧的是柴油，噪音比较大。
柴油.en: This generator runs on diesel and is quite noisy.

无偿.zh: 他把自己收藏的一百多幅画无偿捐给了博物馆。
无偿.en: He donated more than a hundred paintings from his collection to the museum free of charge.

新陈代谢.zh: 年龄越大，人的新陈代谢就越慢，越容易发胖。
新陈代谢.en: The older you get, the slower your metabolism and the easier it is to put on weight.

摄氏度.zh: 在标准大气压下，水在一百摄氏度时会沸腾。
摄氏度.en: At standard atmospheric pressure, water boils at one hundred degrees Celsius.

接连.zh: 这支球队接连输了五场比赛，教练压力很大。
接连.en: This team has lost five matches in a row, and the coach is under great pressure.

惹祸.zh: 他喝了酒就爱乱说话，好几次都因此惹祸。
惹祸.en: He tends to talk nonsense when he drinks, and it has got him into trouble several times.

岔.zh: 我们聊着聊着就把话题岔开了。
岔.en: As we chatted, we drifted off onto another subject.

媳妇.zh: 他娶了个好媳妇，把家里照顾得井井有条。
媳妇.en: He married a good wife, who keeps the household in perfect order.
